historic_survey.note: An office tower addition by Roger Owen Boyer & Associates that set a sunken, tiered Postmodern plaza between and below two retained Neoclassical bank facades, with offices and retail connected by stairs and escalators.

historical_record.description: The Italian American Bank, designed by John Galen Howard, founder of the U.C. Berkeley School of Architecture.
Photographed, showing the Sutro and Company.

unknowns: A design of 1907 is recorded at this address; the assessor dates the building on this parcel to 1986, so the building described may not be the one standing here.
